title: Baths With Overflow: Simplifying Selection
bodyHtml:

Selection Simplified

Overflow is an often overlooked element of Bath design and it’s not easy to know which Baths have overflow without scrolling endless websites and technical sheets — We’ve decided to make it simple.

Explore our growing range of baths with integrated overflow — from sculptural forms to sleek contemporary silhouettes, our collection brings together aesthetic design and peace of mind functionality.


Vita 1500 with Overflow - 1500 x 750 x 550 mm - Perfect for Small Bathrooms

A Bath for Every Design Vision

Our Baths with overflow are available in a wide variety of configurations—from statement freestanding to practical back-to-wall options—ensuring design flexibility across bathroom typologies.

Choose from matte or satin white finishes, through a myriad of design styles, all crafted from premium MarmoTech Stone Composite to deliver enduring comfort and visual harmony.

Design + Peace of Mind
